items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the biographical account 'Bibha Chowdhuri: The Beam of Light that Lit the Path for Women in Indian Science', and answer.

"In a lecture hall full of young men in 1936, one young woman sat in the front row, taking careful notes. Some of her classmates thought she would soon give up. She did not. Years later, the particles she tracked on photographic plates would be discussed by scientists around the world."

Answer the following:
(i) What was unusual about the lecture hall?
(ii) What did some classmates expect?  (a) That she would leave India  (b) That she would soon give up  (c) That she would win a prize the next day  (d) That she would become a teacher at once
(iii) What does "She did not" show about her?
(iv) On what did she track particles?  (a) Telescopes only  (b) Television screens  (c) Photographic plates  (d) Radio sets
items.answer: (i) It was full of young men, with only one young woman. (ii) (b) That she would soon give up (iii) Her determination and perseverance. (iv) (c) Photographic plates
